audit_metadata.audit_name: DAY 7 — AUDIT 5: CROSS-VALIDATION SCOPE, RELIABILITY & GENERALIZABILITY AUDIT

direct_questions_verdict.Q1_cv_internally_valid: YES (VERIFIED). Strict subject-level StratifiedKFold, 0 leakage, 100% development coverage.
direct_questions_verdict.Q2_cv_reproducible: YES (VERIFIED). Metrics and restored states 100% verified from checkpoints and histories.
direct_questions_verdict.Q3_cv_reveals_hidden_instability: YES. Accuracy is steady at 95.3% while LGG Recall swings from 0.0% to 80.0%.
direct_questions_verdict.Q5_explains_historical_discrepancy: PARTIALLY. Proves 0.00% recall occurs naturally on unfavorable splits/early stopping (Fold 4), while 75-80% occurs on favorable splits/longer training (Fold 5).
direct_questions_verdict.Q6_establishes_patient_distribution_effe: YES. Different patient partitions produce divergent sensitivity under identical pipelines.
direct_questions_verdict.Q7_establishes_stochasticity_as_primary_: NO. Multi-seed fixed-split variance has not been decoupled.
direct_questions_verdict.Q8_establishes_locked_test_as_favorable: NO. It shows 75.0% lies in the upper tail of the CV distribution, but does not prove statistical bias.
direct_questions_verdict.Q9_strongest_defensible_interpretation: ResNet18 MedicalNet learns strong, stable latent representations (ROC-AUC = 0.9163 +/- 0.0446), but fixed-threshold minority sensitivity is highly variable across patient partitions (0.5055 +/- 0.3274).
direct_questions_verdict.Q10_future_experiments_needed: 1. 5-seed fixed-split ablation to isolate optimization stochasticity; 2. 5-fold CV on Protocols B & C and DenseNet/Swin; 3. Evaluation of Focal Loss under 5-fold CV.
